integrity: One self-contained analytic proof and numerical cross-check; external independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to stationary, noninteracting bosons under simultaneous full Poisson resets in a harmonic trap. The threshold is implicit, with no classified critical equality normal form. No claims about entanglement, interactions or other reset clocks.
title: A single finite-population mode transition and asymmetric edge laws for a Poisson-reset Bose gas
